title: Geometric connectedness is tested by finite separable extensions
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $Y$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Then $Y$ is geometrically connected over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] if and only if for every finite separable field extension $k'/k$ [def-pc-field-extension] the base change $Y_{k'}=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ [def-pc-base-change] is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme].
